verdict.rationale: Gitea is a free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted service giving 'full control'. Its data lives in standard databases you run yourself (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.), and repositories are Git, so the product's own design keeps data in open formats you hold. However, the pack documents no explicit export or dump feature, and one community user's open question about backup and restore is not a concrete contradiction. missing for 10: documented first-party export/dump tooling covering issues, PRs, wikis and packages in open formats, an explicit migrate-out path to other forges, independent hands-on confirmation of a complete export.
